note: San Juan NF (Dolores RD) campground in a meadow ringed by fir and aspen beside the Dolores River, ~9,400 ft: 6 mi NE of Rico on Hwy 145 (San Juan Skyway, paved), then 0.5 mi on Barlow Creek Rd (FR 578). The electric sites are in Loop A on the river side, behind a band of conifers; non-electric Loop B is set back up the slope. Barlow Creek Rd beyond the campground over Bolam Pass is often limited to 4WD. --Claude
summary: FS page + rec.gov 233250: confirmed 27 sites, 30-amp electric (public, 11 reservable + first-come; counts differ 16/18/19), 50-ft FS max, pull-throughs, vault toilets, potable water, dump ($15), $30/$41 (2027 same), some sites FCFS. Added water hookup false, 14-night limit, booking.season 05-15..09-26, season note. Note trimmed of field restatements.

Electric site count conflict: FS page 16 (11 reservable + 5 FCFS), rec.gov description 18, rec.gov catalog 19 (Loop A sites 2-20; 11 reservable + 8 FCFS). All are public campsites, none a host site. electric: 30 holds either way.
Max length: FS 'Max RV size = 50 ft' recorded; rec.gov catalog lengths of 60/65/70 ft are the usual placeholders.

Riverfront re-audit lead (waterfront NOT changed): on imagery the Dolores River runs along the campground's north edge between it and Hwy 145. The nearest pads (Loop A sites 15, 13, 12, 11, 4, 6) are ~35-45 m from the channel, but behind a continuous band of conifers with no open ground to the water. No site shows an open apron to the river; Loop B (sites 1, 21-27) is 100+ m back. recreation.gov says 'many of which are situated along the river', but under the open-apron rule this reads as riverview at most. Stored riverfront has no waterfront_evidence.

Status: closed for the season (Peak season ended Sep 26), not a status. FR 578 'Barlow Creek' is Open on the San Juan NF road table as of 2026-10-25 after the Oct 22-25 floods. The access is paved Hwy 145.
Pin 37.77067,-107.97883 is 204 m from the centroid of the 16 catalogued site points (37.77137,-107.97668), at the entrance/day-use end of Loop B, inside the campground. OK.
